verify.title: How to verify
verify.intro: Anyone can redo the draw with the data above:
verify.step1: Write the paid numbers in ascending order, separated by commas with no spaces (e.g. 3,7,12). The SHA-256 of that text must equal the published one.
verify.step2: For counter = 0, 1, 2…: compute HMAC-SHA256 with the seed (hex-decoded bytes) as key and the counter as 8 big-endian bytes as message; the first 8 bytes of the result, read as a big-endian unsigned integer, are v.
verify.step3: Let n be the number of participants. If v ≥ ⌊2^64 ÷ n⌋ × n, discard v and use the next counter; otherwise the winner is the number at position v mod n of the list (starting at 0).
verify.docs: Reference code in Python and Go: docs/draw-algorithm.md in the project repository.
verify.ok: Verified: the list hash and the winning number match.
verify.fail: Does not match the published data.
